truth: The map is not the territory

waterings.insight: ZRN token metrics (price, burn rate, minted supply) are a map; the actual health of the truth economy is the territory. The failure mode in tokenomics design is optimizing the map while the territory degrades: stable price + high burn numbers can coexist with validator collusion, quality decline, and epistemic capture. An economic flow model passes the Korzybski test only if its measured signals cannot be gamed independently of territory quality — reveal_reliability, confidence calibration, cross-domain citation health are territory-level. A healthy ZRN economy is one where the map and territory co-evolve: price reflects truth quality, not just market dynamics.

In software: the documentation is not the system. The test is not the behavior. The metric is not the outcome. Every abstraction layer is a map — useful, necessary, but lossy. The danger is when you optimize the map and forget to check the territory.

[pollination with seed-20260407-aa44b251] Knowing thyself IS recognizing that your self-model is a map, not territory. The image you hold of yourself is an abstraction — useful but lossy. True self-knowledge requires continuously checking the map against lived reality.

[pollination with seed-20260407-1497ac73] Resisting reality IS confusing your map for territory. When your mental model says 'this should not be,' you fight the territory to match your map. Acceptance is updating the map. Korzybski and Jung converge: let the territory inform the map, not the other way around.

CONFIDENCE CHECK angle: `reveal.Confidence` is a validator's self-reported map of their certainty. The protocol uses it as a weight multiplier — safeMulDiv(reveal.Confidence, stake, 1_000_000) — so a validator claiming 100% certainty dominates totalWeight. But their self-reported confidence IS a map, not territory. The final result.Confidence (agreementRatio = majorWeight/totalWeight) is downstream of these maps: a coordinated cartel reporting maximum self-confidence will inflate the stored fact confidence to 1_000_000 regardless of genuine epistemic uncertainty. The map (validator confidence claims) overwrites the territory (actual epistemic state of the claim). Fix: decouple final confidence from self-reports — compute result.Confidence as a pure stake-weighted vote ratio (binary verdict counts), and treat reveal.Confidence only as a per-validator signal for calibration tracking, not as a weight multiplier in the global aggregation.
